First run of the tests for ticket #24, before the feature exists, on Pixel_10
(emulator-5554, Android 17), with no code for the ticket written yet.

Base: commit 3bcd4ac, branch ticket-24-read-ticket-fields, tests not yet
committed. Four runs, one after the other, each shown in full below: the new
tests of ticket #24, then the tests of tickets #10, #18 and #22 that this
ticket changed (see docs/tests/24.md, "Changes to the tests of tickets #10,
#18 and #22").

Results:

- Ticket #24 (ticket_fields_driver.dart): 21 fail, 1 passes.
  - 20 fail because the feature is missing: the screen still shows ML Kit's
    own text below the photo, so there is no "Số vé:", "Tỉnh:" or "Ngày:"
    line, and where 4d is expected the old "Không đọc được vé" line shows
    below the photo, with no hint, no "Thử lại" button and the photo still
    there.
  - 1 stopped in setup, not on the feature: "Given the text has "HO CHI
    MINH" ...". The shutter was tapped but the photo screen didn't open within
    the wait, and the camera screen stayed. The app logged no error. This is
    a run problem on the emulator; the test has not yet been seen to fail for
    the missing feature. It was not run again, because the test writer runs
    the new tests once.
  - "Given the shutter was just tapped, when the read hasn't finished, then
    the screen shows the photo and "Đang đọc vé..." as it does today" passes,
    as expected: the ticket says this stays as today.
- Ticket #10 (photo_screen_driver.dart, now on ticket_text_app.dart): 12 fail,
  1 passes. All 12 fail at "the photo screen is open", which now finishes the
  read with a full ticket text and waits for the three lines; the screen shows
  ML Kit's text instead. The first test doesn't wait for a read and passes.
- Ticket #18 (ticket_text_driver.dart): 6 fail, 4 pass. Five fail on the
  three lines missing. The real ML Kit test read the room and the screen showed
  the old "Không đọc được vé" line below the photo, not 4d. The 4 that pass
  don't depend on what shows after a read: the screen opening with "Đang đọc
  vé..." and the three "leave while reading" tests.
- Ticket #22 (photo_crop_driver.dart): 6 fail, 1 passes. All 6 fail on the
  three lines missing, most of them in "a photo was kept earlier", whose read
  now expects the three lines. The first test doesn't wait for a read and
  passes.

The test runner's colour codes were removed from the output below. Nothing
else was changed.

################################################################
SECOND FIRST RUN: the "Camera won't start" items
################################################################

Ticket #24 was changed with /refine after the feature above was built: the
two "Thử lại" / back items in "Sketch 4d" now say "and the camera can start",
and a new section, "Camera won't start", has five items. This is the first
run of the five new tests, in camera_start_driver.dart, on Pixel_10
(emulator-5554, Android 17), before any code for these five items exists.

Base: commit 719a154, branch ticket-24-read-ticket-fields (the rest of #24
already built), new tests not yet committed. The two changed "Sketch 4d"
items keep their existing tests in ticket_fields_driver.dart, which weren't
changed or run again.

Result of the final run (run B below): all 5 fail because the behaviour is
missing. In each one the test's camera refusal or failure reached the app (the
failure message counts the camera starts the test refused or failed: 1 each),
and the app raised no error:

- The two refused-access tests: after "Thử lại" or back, the app stays on 4d.
  No "Cần dùng camera" pop-up shows and the home screen doesn't open.
- The two camera-failure tests from 4d: after "Thử lại" or back, the app
  stays on 4d. No home screen and no "Lỗi camera, thử lại" note.
- The "Quét vé" test: the home screen stays, but no "Lỗi camera, thử lại"
  note shows.

Run A, an earlier try of the same five tests, is kept after run B because
every run's proof is kept. Its tests were broken, not the feature: in the
fake refusal, the camera add-on tried to let go of the photo's camera preview
a second time and failed inside the add-on (IllegalStateException,
"releaseFlutterSurfaceTexture() cannot be called ..."), a state a real
refusal never reaches, because a real refusal is always the camera's first
start since the app opened. The app was then left stuck on 4d, so the other
four tests stopped in SETUP. The fake was fixed to answer that for the
add-on (see docs/tests/24.md, "Camera won't start"), and run B followed.

The test runner's colour codes were removed from the output below. Nothing
else was changed.
